# What yearly rate is the structured settlement buyer charging you?

> Free structured settlement buyout calculator: type the payments you would sell and the cash offered, and see the yearly discount rate the buyer is charging, what the payments are worth at a fair rate, cents on the dollar, and what to counter. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
